requirement_frequency.text: 'The system shall help the user avoid making mistakes while scheduling classes and clinicals for the nursing students.'
'The response time of general student management tasks shall take no longer than 5 seconds and the response time of schedule generation shall take no longer than 30 seconds.'
The system shall protect private information in accordance with the organization's information policy.'
'The maximum wait time for a user navigating from one screen to another within the Disputes application shall be no more than 5 seconds.'
'The Disputes application shall be available 24x7x365 with the exception of the following scheduled maintenance windows. Monday â€“ Saturday 3:00am to 4:00am EST Sunday 1:00amd to 5:00am EST'

'The Disputes application shall interface with the Statement Database. The Statement Database provides the transaction details to the Disputes System. All transaction details must be obtained from the Statement Database'

'The Disputes application shall interface with the Cardmember Information Database. The Cardmember Information Database provides detailed information with regard to a cardmember. All cardmember detail information must be obtained from the Cardmember Information Database.'
'The Disputes application shall ensure that only users with the appropriate access level are allowed to initiate dispute requests.'
'The product shall interface with the Choice Parts System. This provides the feed of recycled parts data.'
'The product shall comply with corporate User Interface Guidelines'
'The search for recycled parts shall take no longer than 15 seconds. The search results shall be returned in under 15 seconds.'
'The search for the preferred repair facility shall take no longer than 8 seconds. The preferred repair facility is returned within 8 seconds'
The response shall be fast enough to avoid interrupting the user's flow of thought. 90% of tasks shall complete within 5 seconds. 98% of tasks shall complete within 8 seconds.'
'Any interface between a user and the automated system shall have a maximum response time of 5 seconds unless noted by an exception below.'
When streaming a movie the buffering time should take no longer than 10 seconds (plus any latency on the user's connection.)'
'The website shall achieve 99.5% up time.'
'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'
'The system shall achieve 95% up time.'
'The system shall have basic data integrity checking to reduce the possibility of incorrect or invalid data being introduced.'
'The product shall achieve a 98% uptime. The product shall not fail more than 2% of the available online time.'
'The system shall prevent malicious attacks including denial of service.'
'The product shall allow the user to select a chosen language from one of the target market countries.'
'The product shall conform to the Americans with Disabilities Act.'
'Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.'
'The product should be able to be used by 90% of novice users on the Internet.'
The system shall interface with CampusConnect's central server'
'The Disputes application shall comply with the corporate standards for user interface creation for internally and externally used applications.'
'The Disputes application shall support 350 concurrent users without any degradation of performance in the application.'

'The Disputes applications shall interface with the Merchant Information Database. The Merchant Information Database provides detailed information with regard to the merchant. All merchant detail information shall be obtained from the Merchant Information Database.'
'The product shall be able to handle up to 1500 simultaneous users. The system shall perform with 1500 users as a time.'
'The product shall be easy to use by Adjusters and Collision Estimators. 95% of Adjusters and Collision Estimators shall find the product easy to use.'
'The product shall be easy to learn by Adjusters and Collision Estimators. The product shall be learned with two days onsite training'
'The system shall cater to 10 simultaneous users from 9am to 5pm.'
'All of the users shall be able to use the system after one day of training.'
'The system shall be expected to manage the nursing program curriculum and class/clinical scheduling for a minimum of 5 years.'

'The Disputes application must maintain a detailed history of every action that a user takes on a dispute case. This ensures a complete audit trail if questions arise later on with regard to a particular dispute case.'
'The Disputes System must prevent users from accessing any dispute cases that do not belong to their cardholder base.'
'The product shall adhere to the corporate Architecture guidelines'

'The product shall be capable of handling up to 1 000 concurrent requests. This number will increase to 2 000 by Release 2. The concurrency capacity must be able to handle peak scheduling times such as early morning and late afternoon hours.'

'The product shall ensure that only company employees or external users with company-approved user IDs may have product access. 100% of all logons shall be by either company employees or external users with company-approved user IDs.'

'The product must be able to interface with any HTML browser. The product shall transmit data between the user and the product without problems. The product shall display HTML properly in 80% of all HTML browsers tested (minimum is to test 8 browsers).'
'The website shall protect itself from intentional abuse and notify the administrator at all occurrences.'
'The website shall make its user aware of its information practices before collection data from them via a Privacy Policy accessible on all pages of the website.'
'system shall be able to handle all of the user requests/usage during business hours.'
'The system shall be easy to use by the Program Administrators/Nursing Staff Members.'
'The list of dispute cases that are displayed after a search is performed must be color coded for easy identification of dispute cases based upon the dispute case status.'
'One insurance company shall not be able to view another insurance companys claim data.'
'The product must make use of web/application server technology. Open source examples include Apache web server Tomcat and the JBoss application server.'
'The product shall create an exception log of problems encountered within the product for transmission to our company for analysis and resolution.'
'The product must be able to interface with various email servers. The product shall be able to send email.'
'When purchasing a streaming movie or pre-paid card via credit card the processing time should have a maximum response time of 15 seconds.'
'Users should be able to access their streaming movies in under 2 clicks after logging into the website.'
'The Disputes application must conform to the legal requirements as specified by Regulation E and Regulation Z that govern credit card disputes processing.'
'The product will function alongside server software on any operating system where the Java runtime can be installed.'
The product's Look and Feel shall be able to incorporate aspects of the customer's organization such as logo branding and identity'
'The product shall be easy to use. 90% of users will be able to successfully reserve a conference room within 5 minutes of product use.'
'The product shall give users feedback when necessary. 80% of the users surveyed report that the product accurately confirms their actions.'
'The website shall be capable of supporting 100 000 customers.'

'The product shall be easy for customers with novice skills on the Internet to purchase and watch streaming movies. Customers should be able to purchase and watch a pre-determined movie in under 3 minutes.'
'Users should only have to navigate through a maximum of 4 pages to create an account with the website.'
'We must be able to interface with any HTML browser.'
Only authorized users shall have access to students' personal information.'
'Only authorized users shall have access to clinical site information.'
'The verbiage used within the system shall be consistent with Standard English and the terminology of the national Nursing Community.'

The Disputes application shall interface with the Cardmember Posting and Billing System. This will allow the Disputes application to request adjustments to cardmember and merchant's accounts. All adjustment requests must be sent to the Cardmember Posting and Billing System.'
'The user shall easily locate instructions while using the product. User help can be found within 90% of the system.'

'The product must work with most database management systems (DBMS) on the market whether the DBMS is colocated with the product on the same machine or is located on a different machine on the computer network.'
'The product must be designed using Design Patterns and coding best practices. 90% of maintenance software developers are able to integrate new functionality into the product with 2 working days.'

The product shall be able to display calendar dates and times according to the user's locale. 90% of survey respondents from each target market country will find that the date and time formatting of the product is correct.'
'The website shall continue to operate if the payment gateway goes down.'
'System shall let existing customers log into the website with their email address and password in under 5 seconds.'
'System shall let administrators generate unique pre-paid pins in under 2 minutes and generate an Excel file with the generated PINs.'
'The website shall continue to operate if the streaming server goes down.'
'The system shall interface with the student master server.'
'The number of mistakes noted by the students shall be decreased by 50% in the first year.'
'The system shall be available for use between the hours of 8am and 6pm.'
'The system shall be intuitive to the Program Administrators/Nursing Staff Members.'
'The system shall be capable of processing 100% of nursing students and their classes for the next 10 years.'
'The Disputes application shall ensure that only authorized users are allowed to logon to the application.'
'The Disputes application shall manipulate and view business data. Users will not have direct access to data files or databases.'
'100% of the cardmember and merchant services representatives shall use the Disputes application regularly after a 2-day training course.'
'The product shall be able to handle 10 000 concurrent users within 2 years of the initial launch.'
'The recycled parts audit report shall be returned to the user within 10 seconds. The audit report shall be returned within 10 seconds.'
'The preferred repair facility ratings shall be saved within 5 seconds. The save shall occur within 5 seconds.'
'Only adjusters with a supervisor role can update preferred repair facility ratings. Users without the supervisor role cannot access the repair facility ratings.'
'The product shall be supported using the corporate support center.'
'The product shall have a conservative and professional appearance.'
'The product shall use a standard navigation menu familiar to most web users.'

'The product will require collaboration with a database management system (DBMS). The DBMS may be located on the same machine as the product or on a separate machine residing on the same computer network.'
'The product shall be able to process 10 000 transactions per hour within two years of its launch. This number will increase to 20 000 by Release 2.'
'The product shall allow for intuitive searching of available conference rooms.'
'The product shall allow for customization of start page and views preferences.'
'Only authorized personnel can access customer records in the database.'
'System shall let Izogn Manager access sales and usage statistics in under 2 minutes.'
'All streaming movie sales will be logged in the database and accessible by the administrator.'
The system shall reveal private information only in compliance with the organization's information policy.'
'The website shall be available for use 24 hours per day 365 days per year.'
'All customer information will be stored on a secure database accessible only to authorized personnel.'
